provenance.native_pose: current decoded installation mapper before anatomical projection/planarization; existing world root copied exactly
provenance.validation: Captured holds only; no independent repeat, blind, cross-user, or physical accuracy validation.
provenance.neutral_boundary: Measured installation-open input maps to the declared installation pose_0 label; root-stage base is never the target.
